g.text: Residue of chain C, numbered as in the structure file
An interface has no centre. The residues of chain C that touch
chains H, L stand in a column, as boxes, ordered along the
interface and not by their sequence: neighbours in the column
are neighbours in space; those of chains H, L around it. A line is
a pair of residues, at the shortest of its contacts of one kind.
All 12 residues of chain C at the interface are shown, with 25
